Where the sounds come from

Each recording (except the phone ring, which was generated for this game) is a short clip of a sound released into the public domain (CC0) by its recordist on Freesound, taken from the ESC-50 environmental sound collection by Karol J. Piczak. CC0 means no permission or attribution is required; credits are listed as a courtesy.
